chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Black bands in Chicago hotels were the exception
summary: Willard and Collins discuss how black bands rarely played Chicago hotels, such as the Hotel La Salle, and mention Eddie South behind a screen.
